name: Darkness Slider
description: Full-screen dark marquee of image cards that drift sideways in a loop while a few random cards light up at a time, with a soft cursor spotlight following the mouse.
contents: Looping row of image cards, each with a tag pill, title and caption
behavior: Cards auto-scroll horizontally and loop seamlessly
A random set of visible cards brightens and glows on an interval while others stay dim
Cards float vertically and scale up on hover
A radial light follows the mouse cursor and the native cursor is hidden
editableByProps: Card images, tags, titles and captions
Scroll speed, glow count and interval, glow color
Image brightness and saturation, background color
Cursor light toggle and size, font family
fixed: Loads the Hanken Grotesk font through Google Fonts link tags
Root is full viewport height and hides the native cursor
Cursor light follows the mouse only, no touch equivalent
